job.job_description:
Location: Hyderabad, Bangalore
Experience: 6 8.5 Years
Job Type: Full-time

Overview

We are looking for a passionate and experienced AI/ML & Generative AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy intelligent applications using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI technologies. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in AI/ML solutions, GenAI frameworks, cloud integrations, and Python/R-based workflows to solve real-world business challenges.

You will work with modern AI tools and technologies such as GitHub Copilot, Gemini, LangChain, LLM agents/assistants, and cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP to build scalable and impactful AI-driven solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI solutions using LLMs and related technologies.
Build GenAI applications, AI agents, and intelligent assistants using frameworks such as LangChain.
Utilize tools like GitHub Copilot and Gemini to improve development productivity and accelerate solution delivery.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and third-party services.
Develop scalable cloud-native AI solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP platforms.
Create end-to-end data pipelines and workflows using Python or R for model training, evaluation, and deployment.
Fine-tune, optimize, and evaluate LLMs for domain-specific use cases.
Implement responsible AI practices, prompt engineering, and output quality validation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, and business stakeholders.

Required Skills

6 – 8.5 years of experience in AI/ML with hands-on expertise in Generative AI and LLM-based solutions.
Strong experience with LLMs such as GPT, Llama, Gemini, Mistral, or similar models.
Hands-on experience with LangChain or similar frameworks for building GenAI agents and assistants.
Strong programming skills in Python and/or R.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Knowledge of APIs, RESTful services, and cloud integrations.
Understanding of Machine Learning, NLP, prompt engineering, and vector databases.
Experience with CI/CD, MLOps, and DevOps practices.
Familiarity with tools such as Pinecone, FAISS, ChromaDB, Docker, and Kubernetes.
